per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be intuitive and require minimal training, with a maximum of one day of training for core staff and a shorter orientation for adjuncts and site coordinators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with common browsers and devices without requiring special plugins or installations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'We must be able to interface with any HTML browser.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have a response time of a few seconds for routine tasks and up to 30 seconds for batch processing.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available 95% of the time during business hours, with a tolerance for rare outages.
The system should implement role-based access control to restrict access to sensitive information based on user roles.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Only authorized users shall have access to clinical site information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should follow university policies for data privacy and security, including compliance with information policies and audit trails.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with the university's student records and HR or payroll systems to avoid manual data entry.
The system should handle 10-15 concurrent users during peak times without slowing down.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'system shall be able to handle all of the user requests/usage during business hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement validation rules to prevent overlapping schedules, missing clearances, and other obvious human errors.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide immediate notifications and acknowledgment tracking for schedule changes and other important updates.
The system should provide automated reports for daily rosters, clearance status, cohort progression, and other relevant data.
The system should minimize the need for printing and reduce paper usage.
